name: OS-App Iteration Cycle — Polish, Harden, Test, Optimize
description: Complete polish plan (batches 9-10), harden UI/UX, expand test coverage to 90%+ on critical paths, and optimize bundle performance with lazy loading and code splitting.

userStories.title: Polish Batch 9 — Component Logger Migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all 23 component files migrated from console.* to logger.* so that production logging is consistent and controllable.
acceptanceCriteria: All 23 files listed in POLISH_PLAN.md Batch 9 use import { logger } from '@/services/logger' (adjust relative path as needed)
Zero console.log/warn/error calls remain in those 23 files (verify with: grep -rn 'console\.' on each file)
components/voice/VoiceManager/index.tsx (16 calls) fully migrated
components/MasterStabilizationProtocol.tsx (5 calls) fully migrated
No behavioral changes — logger calls match original severity levels (log→info, warn→warn, error→error)
npx tsc --noEmit passes
npx vitest run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: Completed: all 23 component files migrated to logger.*

userStories.title: Dead Code Sweep — Components and Hooks
userStories.description: As a developer, I want unused components and hooks identified and archived to .graveyard/ so the codebase stays lean.
acceptanceCriteria: Import analysis run across all 75+ components in components/ — list of unreferenced components produced
Import analysis run across all 28+ hooks in hooks/ — list of unreferenced hooks produced
Disconnected code with real logic archived to .graveyard/ with MANIFEST.md entries (original path, capability, why disconnected, how to recover)
Empty stubs and () => null components deleted outright
Git history checked for each candidate: git log --all -p -S 'import.*ComponentName' to verify disconnection
No build regressions: npm run build succeeds
npx tsc --noEmit passes
npx vitest run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: .graveyard/ already exists. Follow dead-code-policy: archive don't delete. Check git history before removing.

userStories.title: Accessibility Audit — Interactive Components
userStories.description: As a user, I want all interactive components to be keyboard-navigable and screen-reader accessible so the app meets WCAG AA.
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons, links, and controls have aria-label or visible text
All modals trap focus and support Escape to close
Tab order is logical across Dashboard, CommandPalette, AgentControlCenter
Color contrast ratios meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large text)
Form inputs have associated labels (htmlFor or aria-labelledby)
No div or span used as interactive element without role and tabIndex
npx tsc --noEmit passes
npx vitest run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: Batch 1 of polish plan already added some aria labels. Build on that work.

userStories.title: Error Boundary Coverage
userStories.description: As a user, I want graceful error handling across all major views so crashes don't white-screen the app.
acceptanceCriteria: GlobalErrorBoundary wraps the app root in index.tsx
Each major panel has a local error boundary: Dashboard, AgentControlCenter, BiometricPanel, VoiceManager
Error boundaries show a recovery UI with Retry action (not just a blank screen)
Error boundaries log to logger.error with component stack trace
Existing GlobalErrorBoundary.tsx component is reused or extended (not duplicated)
npx tsc --noEmit passes
npx vitest run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: GlobalErrorBoundary.tsx already exists in components/. Verify its current coverage before adding new boundaries.

userStories.title: Lazy Loading — Heavy Dependencies
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to load fast by deferring heavy libraries until needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Three.js (@react-three/fiber, three) loaded only when 3D visualization component is opened — use React.lazy or dynamic import()
face-api.js loaded only when BiometricPanel is activated — use dynamic import()
mermaid loaded only when MermaidDiagram component renders — use dynamic import()
d3 loaded only when chart components (recharts is separate, focus on direct d3 usage) render
Initial bundle size reduced by at least 30% compared to before (measure with npm run build, note sizes before and after)
Loading states (spinner or skeleton) shown while lazy chunks download
npx tsc --noEmit passes
npx vitest run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: Measure baseline bundle size FIRST with npm run build before making changes. Record in notes.

userStories.title: Code Splitting — Route-Level
userStories.description: As a developer, I want route-level code splitting so each major view is its own chunk.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard, AgentControlCenter, BiometricPanel, HardwareEngine are lazy-loaded via React.lazy()
Suspense boundaries with fallback UI (spinner or skeleton) wrap each lazy component
Vite build output shows separate chunks per major view (verify in dist/ after build)
No flash of unstyled content during chunk loading
Navigation between views works without full page reload
npx tsc --noEmit passes
npx vitest run passes
npm run lint passes
userStories.notes: Check App.tsx to understand how views are currently rendered before adding lazy loading.
